text: So tawii Ɓee Yahuudɓe mbi'aama: goonɗinee goonga e peewal ko Alla jippini dow Nulaaɗo Makko, ɓe mbi'a: miɗen ngoonɗini ko jippinaa dow annabaaɓe amen, ɓe njedda ko jippinaa dow Muhammadu (jkm), tawa noon ko oo Kur'aan woni goonga jahduɗo e ko ɓe njogii ko, tawno ɓe ngoonɗinii ko jippinaa e maɓɓe maa ɓe ngoonɗin Kur'aana o. Wii ɓe -Aan annabi-: ko waɗi oɗon mbarannoo Annabaaɓe Alla ɓe so tawno oɗon ngoonɗini goonga garɗo e mon o?!
